purpose: Post-selection engineering diagnostics only; never change the frozen nomination or train on confirmation cases
cases: Two development cases per track, chosen by the smallest SHA256 of diag:<case-id>, independent of correctness
generation_controls: On the identical unadapted publisher checkpoint, compare direct label-logit scoring, greedy one-token labels, and generated JSON with a probability array. Validate returned contracts and report failures; no speedup claim from invalid or truncated JSON.
head_optimization: After loading the frozen adapter/readout, replace the unused full language output projection with the ten candidate-code rows. Check probability and argmax parity before timing. Do not claim a new confirmation result for this diagnostic transformation.
batch_scope: Repeated fixed public example, identical information per item; prepared-input forward-plus-scoring throughput only. Excludes media decoding, processor, queueing, network and startup. Not a production throughput claim.
hardware_probe: Run the same frozen MiniCPM candidate on L4 after H100 confirmation; compare outputs on the same development diagnostic cases. A separate probe, not a replacement for matched-H100 selection.
